text:
Asha (Product): quick design q — should we move the KMS / region pill into the left sidebar (so it’s visible on every page) or keep it inside the Data retention card? link to mock: https://rwd.example/s/retention-mock :thinking:
Liam (Design): sidebar would make key ownership feel more global, but it takes up vertical space there. current mock puts it inline because retention is the main setting on the page.
Diego (Eng): fyi moving to sidebar means we have to fetch customer key metadata on all console pages — slightly higher perf/cost. doable but needs a new endpoint or caching. @Maya might be a11y impact either way.
Maya (Accessibility): main a11y concern is focus order and screen-reader context. If it’s in sidebar it should be announced as "cryptographic settings" and not lose relation to the retention control. Also avoid ambiguous label: "Managed key" alone is confusing.
Asha (Product): good call — our PM goal is "clear ownership + minimal clicks". what about keeping region pill in the header and the key ownership inline with retention? that splits them but keeps ownership contextual.
Liam (Design): visual proposal: header shows region pill + small tooltip "Region for storage and residency". retention card shows a compact row: [Encrypt: Managed key ▼] [Key owner: AcmeCorp] [Manage link]. mock snippet:
```
Encrypt: Managed key (AcmeCorp)  ⓘ
Tooltip: "Managed keys are stored by Redwood. To bring-your-own-key, click Manage."
```
Would simplify scanning.
Diego (Eng): that tooltip copy is fine but pls ensure we include TTL semantics for retention default. backend stores retention as seconds; frontend currently shows "30 days" but the api sometimes returns null/default. Need explicit wording for default vs override.
Asha (Product): suggested tooltip for retention default: "Default retention is 30 days unless overridden by your account policy."
Maya (Accessibility): nit — the tooltip must be accessible: use aria-describedby + role="note" and ensure focusable help icon. Also when the user toggles "Encrypt" the change should be announced with polite aria-live: "Encryption setting updated: Managed key".
Diego (Eng): noted. also audit log change: timestamps are currently UTC in the logs. Product asked to show local timezone with a hover UTC badge. Copy in audit rows should read: "2025-06-15 14:23 (PDT) — Key rotation initiated by alice@acme.com" rather than jumbled timezone codes.
Liam (Design): prefer small secondary text for timezone instead of parentheses, e.g. "2025-06-15 14:23 — PDT" so it’s readable in narrow layouts.
Asha (Product): agree. also two copy suggestions for audit export button: current label "Export" is vague. propose "Export audit CSV" and add a tooltip: "Includes timestamps in your local timezone."
Maya (Accessibility): ensure export dialog has clear confirmation and keyboard focus lands on the primary action. Screen readers should announce file format and column count.
Diego (Eng): implementation plan: 1) keep region pill in header; 2) keep key ownership inline with retention card; 3) add tooltip copy and aria attributes; 4) change audit timestamps to local display with UTC hover; 5) rename export button. I can land a PR that updates the frontend strings + aria hooks, but need product signoff on exact copy.
Asha (Product): final copy decisions: retention tooltip (approved): "Default retention is 30 days unless overridden by your account policy."
Asha (Product): encrypt tooltip (approved): "Managed keys are stored by Redwood. To use your own key (BYOK), choose Manage."
Liam (Design): I'll update the mock and push the narrow-layout variant.
Maya (Accessibility): I'll do a quick a11y checklist and add it to the PR.
Diego (Eng): making a ticket now: RW-4021 — sidebar/key-perf followup; RW-4022 — retention & tooltip copy + aria; RW-4023 — audit timestamp local display + export label. tagging @deploy-bot for deployment note. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window: 2025-06-20 02:00 UTC for UI copy changes.
Asha (Product): thanks all — I'll add the accepted copy to the style guide and loop in docs for the audit export note. :eyes:
